what_happened.line: The School Building Committee held its final meeting; the minutes record the school project as finished on time and under its approved budget, based on spending to date.
A motion to approve the final construction requisition, mostly retainage that closes out the contract, was made; the vote result was not audible.
A motion to acknowledge that unspent contract money is credited back and moved from the GMP contingency to the project contingency was made; the result was not audible.
Closeout schedule set: final payment issued January 16, forms to the School Committee January 17, final selectmen signatures January 23, then the package goes to MSBA.
The local share is expected to come in under the funding agreement figure, but MSBA will decide the final number.

why_it_matters: The local share of the school's cost is what local taxpayers carry, and it stays provisional until the state school building authority (MSBA) sets the final number after its audit.
The motion results were not audible in the captions, so the votes on the last payment and the contingency move should be confirmed against the official minutes.
